exercises.name: Boot Sequence - Stand up to stretch and move
exercises.subtitle: Stand Up + Neck + Shoulders + Wrists
exercises.description: 1. Stand up 2. Neck — turn left/right 3. Shoulders — roll forward and backwards 4. Wrists — rotate, extend arm, pull fingers back.

exercises.name: Clear Cache
exercises.subtitle: Eye Break: 10-10-10
exercises.description: Close eyes for 10 seconds. Open, focus on something 20 feet away for 10 seconds. Repeat 3 times. Flush the pixel buffer. Reduce eye strain before it becomes a bug.

exercises.name: Refactor Your Spine
exercises.subtitle: Seated Back Twist
exercises.description: Seated tall, twist your torso gently left. Hold 5 sec. Then right. Hold 5 sec. 6 reps per side. Your spine's architecture needs refactoring after hours of hunching.

exercises.name: Offline Mode
exercises.subtitle: Walk Away
exercises.description: Step away from the screen. Walk around: kitchen, hallway, outside if possible. No phone. No Slack. You are temporarily offline. This is a feature, not a bug. Enjoy it.

exercises.name: Memory Garbage Collection
exercises.subtitle: Box Breathing
exercises.description: Inhale 4 sec → hold 4 sec → exhale 7 sec. Clear the stack. Free the memory. Reduce cognitive load before the next sprint.

exercises.name: Extend Your Reach
exercises.subtitle: Overhead Arm Stretch
exercises.description: Reach both arms overhead, interlace fingers, stretch tall. Lean gently side to side. 20 sec each direction. Extending your physical API endpoints after a long session.

exercises.name: Lint Your Posture - Shoulder Rolls
exercises.subtitle: Posture Check
exercises.description: Ears over shoulders. Shoulders back and down. Screen at eye level. Feet flat on floor. Hold this correct posture for 20 sec. Run the linter. Fix the warnings. Zero errors.

exercises.name: git remove pee && git add water
exercises.subtitle: Hydration Reminder
exercises.description: Go pee and drink water. Right now. Seriously. git commit -m 'stay hydrated' && git push. Your brain is 75% water and you have not been watering it. This commit is non-negotiable.

exercises.name: Full Stack Reach with Deep Squat Rotation
exercises.subtitle: Deep Squat Rotation
exercises.description: Feet wide, drop into a deep squat. Place one hand on the ground, reach the other arm straight up while rotating your chest toward the ceiling. Hold 5 sec. Switch sides. 5 reps each. Full-stack mobility — from the lowest layer all the way to the top of the architecture.

exercises.name: Building the Core - Squats
exercises.subtitle: Squats
exercises.description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Lower into a squat as if sitting back into a chair. Keep chest up and knees over toes. Rise back up. 2 sets × 15 reps. Strengthen the core of your body and your codebase.

exercises.name: Building the Core - Planks
exercises.subtitle: Planks
exercises.description: Forearms on the ground, body in a straight line from head to heels. Engage your core and hold. 3 sets × 30 sec. Strengthen the core of your body and your codebase.

exercises.name: Spider Crawl Protocol
exercises.subtitle: Quadruped Hold
exercises.description: Hands and knees on the floor — wrists under shoulders, knees under hips. Back flat like a table, no sagging. Hold 30 sec breathing steadily. For extra credit: extend opposite arm and leg and hold 5 sec each side. Your core infrastructure needs as much maintenance as your codebase.

exercises.name: Cat Stretch Protocol
exercises.subtitle: Cat, Cat-Cow Stretch
exercises.description: Well, Cat stretch: on all fours, round your back up like a cat. Hold 5 sec. Then Cow stretch: drop belly down, lift chest and tailbone up. Hold 5 sec. Your backend systems need regular stretching to prevent stiffness and downtime.

exercises.name: git pull fresh air
exercises.subtitle: Breath of Fresh Air
exercises.description: Step outside or open a window. Take 3 deep breaths of fresh air. Inhale the new ideas, exhale the stress and fatigue. A breath of fresh air can be the best commit message for your mental state.

exercises.name: Committing Protocol - Time to commit more work?!
exercises.subtitle: Time to commit more work?!
exercises.description: Time to commit more work?! Take a moment to reflect on what you've accomplished. Celebrate the wins, no matter how small. Then, if you have the energy, plan your next commit. But remember, it's okay to push an empty commit just to acknowledge the hard work you've done.

exercises.name: Building the Core - Pushups
exercises.subtitle: Pushups
exercises.description: Start in a high plank position with hands shoulder-width apart. Lower your body until your chest nearly touches the floor. Push back up to the starting position. 3 sets × 15 reps. Strengthen the core of your body and your codebase.

exercises.name: Core Deployment - Ab Wheel Rollouts
exercises.subtitle: Ab Wheel Rollouts
exercises.description: Kneel with ab wheel in hands. Roll forward slowly, extending hips and arms, core braced. Roll back with control. 3 sets of 8-12 reps. Protect the rollout. No sagging under load.

exercises.name: Backend Stability - Bird Dogs
exercises.subtitle: Bird Dogs
exercises.description: Hands and knees, extend right arm + left leg straight. Hold 3 sec, return. Alternate sides. 3 sets of 8-10 per side. Anti-rotation training for a stable core server.

exercises.name: Posterior Commit - Barbell Glute Bridge
exercises.subtitle: Barbell Glute Bridge
exercises.description: Supine, bar across hips (use pad). Drive heels, lift hips to full extension, squeeze glutes hard at top for 1 sec. Lower. 3 sets x 10-12. Ship power from the glutes.

exercises.name: Log Shipping - Supermans
exercises.subtitle: Supermans
exercises.description: Lie face down, arms forward. Lift chest, arms, and legs simultaneously. Hold 2 sec at top. 3 sets x 10-15. Strengthen the lower back erectors that keep your stack upright.

exercises.name: Hinge Sync - Band Good Mornings
exercises.subtitle: Band Good Mornings
exercises.description: Band under feet, looped behind neck or over shoulders. Hinge hips back with neutral spine, soft knees. Feel hamstring tension. Return by driving hips forward. 3 sets x 10-12. Master the hinge to avoid backend errors.

exercises.name: Unstable Core - Stability Ball Planks
exercises.subtitle: Stability Ball Planks
exercises.description: Place forearms or hands on small stability ball in plank. Keep body straight as ball shifts under you. Hold. 3 sets x 20-40 sec. Forces deeper core activation under variable load.

exercises.name: Heavy Deploy - Barbell Squats
exercises.subtitle: Barbell Squats
exercises.description: Bar on traps, brace core, descend until thighs parallel or below, knees track over toes. Drive through midfoot to stand. 3-4 sets x 6-10. Load the system. Then ship it.
